original_claim_text: Resolver V2 achieved 0.00% false merge rate and proved false merge rate < 0.1%
reconciled_finding: Achieved 0.00% false merges on 55 negative benchmark pairs (95% Wilson CI: [0.00% - 6.53%]). Proving error rate < 0.1% requires N >= 3,000 true negative pairs without errors.
mandatory_remedy: Report exact sample size N=55 negative pairs and Wilson CI [0.00% - 6.53%]. Retract claim of <0.1% error rate.

original_claim_text: Cryptographic SHA-256 evidence ledger verifies complete provenance across all 28 anchor employers and observations.
reconciled_finding: Cryptographic SHA-256 ledger verifies immutability of primary source documents and bulk raw JSON/HTML snapshots. Row-level observation hashing is designed for Sprint 3B.3.3.
mandatory_remedy: Clarify in documentation and API responses that ledger validates source payload snapshots, with entity-level hashing slated for next sprint.

original_claim_text: In-memory storage on Render Free tier operates with zero OOM risk.
reconciled_finding: In-memory dataset heap (~0.84 MB for 100 employers) presents negligible baseline heap usage, but unbounded JSON serialization and concurrent burst requests on Render 512 MB RAM present OOM risks.
mandatory_remedy: Mandate pagination (limit=25, max=50) and lazy serialization on employer API endpoints before production load.

original_claim_text: Guarantees 100% empirical data lineage with zero synthetic fallback data.
reconciled_finding: Enforces strict rejection of synthetic fallbacks for statutory demand metrics; missing or unverified data returns explicit null/withheld status.
mandatory_remedy: Refine phrasing to state platform policy enforces 100% empirical source lineage by withholding unverified metrics.

original_claim_text: 5-token contextual co-occurrence window achieves 100% precision on skill extraction.
reconciled_finding: 100% accuracy was achieved on the 20 adversarial edge cases tested. General production vacancy text will encounter unhandled colloquial edge cases.
mandatory_remedy: Tag skill extractions with sample size N in UI and state accuracy is benchmark-verified on curated edge-case suite.

original_claim_text: Confidence scores of 0.95 represent 95% mapping probability.
reconciled_finding: Confidence scores generated by rule-based heuristic similarity are monotonic rankings, not calibrated probabilities. Calibrated probabilities require post-hoc scaling.
mandatory_remedy: Explicitly label scores as heuristic match indices until independent temperature scaling is implemented.
